declaration_time_precision: Minute-level approximate wall time before new numerical comparisons; command/file timestamps provide exact execution times
purpose: New source-based independent review; existing PASS results are evidence under review, not adopted conclusions

tolerances_before_new_comparisons.keys_labels_counts_folds: Exact equality, zero unexpected missing values or mismatches
tolerances_before_new_comparisons.NaN: Both sides undefined with matching documented empty-support or unavailable reason; never treat NaN as zero
tolerances_before_new_comparisons.CSV_rounding: Machine CSV numeric tolerance above; human-formatted report values compared at their printed precision

interpretation: Arithmetic agreement is separate from source lineage, fitted prediction accuracy, statistical validity and actionable causal identification. No conclusion or recommendation is predetermined.
